message: Function parameters must use a stable parameter prefix convention

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' parameters must use the a_ prefix (language receivers self/cls and *args/**kwargs keep conventional names)

rationale: A stable parameter prefix distinguishes parameters from locals and supports searchability. Language-level receivers (self, cls) and variadic packs (args, kwargs) are Python method conventions for those parameter slots, not application parameter names.
remediation: Rename application parameters with the a_ prefix, e.g. def process(a_path: Path, a_limit: int). Keep self/cls and *args/**kwargs unchanged.
